name: popover
title: Popover
description: A floating sheet anchored to the button that opens it.
use: Content that belongs to one button and can be left at any time: a share link, a short form, a few settings. The page stays usable around it and an outside click or Escape closes it. With popover="hint" and interestfor on the trigger it is a preview shown on hover and focus.

instead.when: The task must be finished or dismissed before the page is used again
The content is a list of actions
It is a few words that name a control, with nothing in it to act on
It picks the value of a form field from a list

keyboard.action: On the button with popovertarget: open or close the popover. Focus stays on the button unless an element inside has autofocus
Move from the button into the popover, which is next in the tab order
Close the popover and return focus to its button

platform.feature: The popover attribute with popovertarget, or commandfor with command="toggle-popover"
platform.fallback: Supported in all current browsers: the popover opens, closes on an outside click or Escape and reports aria-expanded on its button without script. Where no button can point at it, call showPopover() and hidePopover() from script; the stylesheet is the same
The popover still opens and closes; it appears centered in the viewport, where the browser places any popover
The popover appears and leaves at once, without the fade
The trigger works as a plain link or button and the preview does not appear

classes.name: popover
classes.description: The floating sheet, on an element with the popover attribute; without the attribute it is never shown. It opens below its button, lined up with the start edge, at a distance of --anchored-gap (6px), and flips at the viewport edge

classes.name: popover-end
classes.description: Lines up with the button's end edge, for a button at the end of a row

classes.name: popover-top
classes.description: Opens above the button; it combines with popover-end or popover-center

properties.name: --popover-max-width
properties.description: Widest the sheet grows before its text wraps

properties.name: --anchored-gap
properties.description: Space between the surface and the control that opened it; 6px when not set

example: Anyone with the link can view the latest deployment.
